messages:
Liz (Sales): Quick help — prepping term sheet for Acme. They want API + Redwood Optimize + Console retention add-on. 12mo commit, starting 50M tokens/mo. Requesting 30% off list across products and include Optimize at per-seat rate. Is that plausible?
Sam (AE): High level: POC needs Optimize for evals — we'll scope 3 seats. For API: do they need burst capacity / Dedicated later? They mentioned strict latency SLOs.
Liz (Sales): They want to start hosted, move to Dedicated after successful POC. Commit = 50M tokens/mo for 12mo. They explicitly asked whether cross-product discounts stack with committed token tiers.
Tara (Deal Desk): We do allow cross-product bundling but we typically cap stacking. Default cap = 25% combined unless there's an uplift/longer commit. @Mike can you run margin / exception calc? Any precedent to cite?
Mike (Finance): Baseline price signals: API token list = $0.0006/token, Optimize seat = $1500/mo, Console retention = $400/mo. 
 - 50M tokens -> API list = $30,000/mo.
 - 30% off -> API = $21,000/mo which would breach our hosted margin floor.
We could do ~27% if they move to 24mo or add an 80% usage floor. Quick formula I used: `api_monthly = tokens * 0.0006 * (1 - discount)`
Raj (Security): SQ flags: they require SOC2 + KMS + VPC peering for Dedicated. If they start hosted we need written confirmation on data retention & deletion. Security questionnaire will add ~3-4 weeks to timeline.
Anna (Product): Optimize notes: eval compute credits aren't included in seat price. For a POC we can waive the first month for 3 seats, but more than that needs product approval. Also confirm which Optimize features they want (regression alerts, dataset retention).
Jordan (CSM): Billing/ops note: cross-product discount must be applied on a single invoice/account to be tracked. Migration to Dedicated changes billing entity which complicates credits — we should include a "migration credit" term to smooth transition. Retention add-on billed per-app, not per-seat.
Tara (Deal Desk): Proposed offer to table: 25% off API + 20% off Optimize seats (first month waived for 3 seats) + 15% off Console retention. 12mo commit with 80% usage floor. Add migration credit: 2 months of API at discounted rate if they sign Dedicated within 12 months. Legal to review special term re: stacking.
Legal (Corp): Ok to proceed but add promo exclusion clause: "promotions and partner credits may not be stacked beyond approved deal desk concessions." Also require customer's PO and standard indemnities.
Liz (Sales): Great — I'll present this package to Acme and ask for a PO. POC aims to start in 2 weeks. Any objections?
Sam (AE): None from me. :thumbsup:
Tara (Deal Desk): No objections. I'll draft the approval memo and attach to the deal.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Dedicated provisioning lead time is ~4-6 weeks after PO + infra approval.
Mike (Finance): FYI I'll model the 25/20/15 scenario vs 27/15/10 and send a quick spreadsheet to this thread by EOD.
Raj (Security): I'll start the initial SQ answers and flag anything high-risk. Need customer contact for KMS & network.
Liz (Sales): Thanks all — looping in Acme's procurement in separate thread.
